text: The urinalysis shows no signs of infection, and the ultrasound indicates excellent bladder emptying, which effectively rules out a simple urinary tract infection or urinary retention. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Interstitial Cystitis/Bladder Pain Syndrome. The combination of chronic suprapubic pain relieved by voiding, urinary frequency, and dyspareunia, in the setting of a negative urinalysis and normal bladder ultrasound, is classic for this condition. Your history of lithium use is also a relevant factor as it can predispose to nephrogenic diabetes insipidus or exacerbate symptoms, but the clinical picture strongly points to IC/BPS.
